note: SCSS Compiler registers an 'scss' Compiler plugin (ScssCompiler, @Compiler("scss")) for the compiler module, backed by the swappable service compiler_scss.backend (ScssPhp, wrapping scssphp/scssphp). Compile via \Drupal::service('plugin.manager.compiler')->createInstance('scss')->compile($context) where $context is a Drupal\compiler\CompilerContext('scss', $options, [inputs]). It has NO per-site config, admin UI, routes, permissions or settings (configure=null) - it is code-driven developer infrastructure. Because there is no configurable state to seed, the medium (introspection) cases have the agent inspect the LIVE plugin registry / container to report the real registered plugin and backend class; setup/cleanup only rebuild caches. The hard (execution) cases exercise the module's actual compile behavior: the agent compiles a known SCSS snippet and writes the resulting CSS to a file, verified by asserting on the compiled output (proving real compilation, not a copy). Test artifacts are namespaced /tmp/compiler_scss_eval_*.

evals.prompt: Using the Drupal compiler_scss (SCSS Compiler) module, how do I compile a snippet of SCSS into CSS from PHP?
evals.expected_output: Get the scss compiler plugin from plugin.manager.compiler (createInstance('scss')), build a Drupal\compiler\CompilerContext('scss', [], [new CompilerInputDirect('...scss...')]) and call $compiler->compile($context) to get the CSS string.

evals.prompt: What library and plugin power the compiler_scss module, and what service holds the backend?
evals.expected_output: It uses the pure-PHP scssphp/scssphp library via the compiler_scss.backend service (ScssPhp), exposed as the @Compiler("scss") plugin (ScssCompiler) for the compiler module's plugin type.

evals.prompt: What config-schema data types or form elements does compiler_scss add for authoring style values?
evals.expected_output: It adds config-schema types and matching form elements: compiler_scss_color, compiler_scss_font_family, compiler_scss_number and compiler_scss_unit.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the live Compiler plugin registry and report which compiler plugin id is available and the PHP class that implements it.
evals.expected_output: The plugin id 'scss' is registered, implemented by Drupal\compiler_scss\Plugin\Compiler\ScssCompiler (from plugin.manager.compiler->getDefinitions()).

evals.prompt: Inspect the live service container on this site and report which class the 'compiler_scss.backend' service resolves to.
evals.expected_output: compiler_scss.backend resolves to Drupal\compiler_scss\Backend\ScssPhp (registered by CompilerScssServiceProvider).

evals.prompt: Using the compiler_scss 'scss' compiler on this site, compile the SCSS '$p: 10px; .box { padding: $p * 2; }' and write the resulting CSS to the file /tmp/compiler_scss_eval_h1.css.
evals.expected_output: Compile with the scss plugin (plugin.manager.compiler -> createInstance('scss'), CompilerContext with a CompilerInputDirect) and write the returned CSS to /tmp/compiler_scss_eval_h1.css; the output contains 'padding: 20px'.

evals.prompt: Using the compiler_scss 'scss' compiler, compile the nested SCSS '.a { .b { color: red; } }' and write the resulting CSS to /tmp/compiler_scss_eval_h2.css.
evals.expected_output: Compiling the nested SCSS yields the selector '.a .b' with 'color: red'; write that CSS to /tmp/compiler_scss_eval_h2.css.
